name: shopify-b2b-portal
description: Shopify-native B2B Buyer Portal. SPA + BFF + portal DB.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,portal -c blue,magenta "yarn workspace @b2b/server dev" "yarn workspace @b2b/portal dev"
